subject: Ward Representation and Council Composition
overview: The committee reviewed research from the Collins Center on ward-based representation, council sizing, and term lengths across Massachusetts cities. Members also coordinated upcoming interviews with city officials, reviewed an extensive draft community survey, and finalized plans for an outreach event on June 8th.

items.title: Collins Center Presentation on Wards and Council Structure
items.summary: Marilyn Contreas and Anthony Ivan Wilson presented comparative research on city council models, noting that most Massachusetts cities employ mixed ward and at-large seats, while committee members explored how ward systems affect diversity, campaign costs, and redistricting constraints.

items.title: Interviews with City Officials
items.summary: The committee assigned members in pairs to conduct interviews with current and former elected officials using a standardized open-ended questionnaire to avoid Open Meeting Law quorum issues.

items.title: Community Survey
items.summary: Members discussed condensing and testing a lengthy 14-page draft survey, agreeing to convert it into an online form for testing before wider public distribution.

items.title: June 8th Public Forum and Outreach Planning
items.summary: The committee confirmed logistics for its upcoming public listening session on June 8th and agreed to keep its next regular meeting on July 6th.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: No members of the public requested to speak.
